title: Unbound 2 common values
description: Reusable value and list definitions for Unbound 2 JSON layers.

integer.description: Reader integer: JSON number, boolean, or signed decimal/hex string.

number.description: Reader number: JSON number or decimal/exponent/hex integer string.

nullablePath.description: Resource path or an explicit absent resource.

vector.description: Three reader numbers; extra values are ignored by the reader.

integerVector.description: Three reader integers; extra values are ignored by the reader.

rgb.description: RGB colour values read as integer bytes.

rgba.description: RGBA colour values read as integer bytes.

layerDirectives.description: Unbound merge directives accepted in object layers.

$replace.description: Discard the lower-layer object when true.

$order.description: Order keys in a keyed list.

keyedList.description: Object-keyed list; $order is meaningful for keyed lists.

positionalList.description: Object keyed by contiguous decimal indices after merge.
